The lower level (230 cells, the exit and 81 of the 184 slots) is joined to the upper only by a drop off the brink onto its bridge, one way: TODO(m6-abode-lower-level). 102 of the 184 slots stand in the two halves (54 east, 48 west; the tour, 83 cells); one more stands in the pit cell 0x5B4802A9 itself, where no walk stands (item 3's hand-set no_go of the west half's 139 cells is replaced by the draft's reach; TODO(m6-holding-pockets) and TODO(m6-holding-walk) are closed). The body run arrives on every leg; none is walked over 30 per cent, 0.067 of all legs (m6-dungeon-run-share, closed in M6 7 F, on the east half's legs); the leg's stop rules are the den's (stop within 1.0 m, dwell 0.25 s, a leg at most 90 s)

The 18 Tusker's Friend pressure plates are not no_go cells (five of their cells hold Rampager slots and corridors the walk needs) but walls inside the cells (the plates section, M6 14 holding plates, TODO(m6-holding-plates) closed): no step of a walk comes within a plate's wall, a standing long jump passes over the walls where they close the way, and a tour leg never ends inside one (RunnerLegs.GoalOutOfAvoid). sources.spell_plan: M6 14 holding safety (closes m6-holding-spell-vii-crossing): the ladder's own rule, as the Abode's and the Quarters' rows. The rows are the base skill's projection: SpellPlan.LevelAt at the ladder's plan_cast_chance 0.95 over SpellPlan.ProjectedWarBase, read on the planner of M6 item 14 with the retail dats (HoldingKitTests pins every level of the band): 65 base 290 and 66 are V, 67 base 293 is VI, 123 is VI, 124 base 343 is VII and 126 base 344 is VII. Levels 65 and 66 are V on the base skill, a level this ground's kit does not carry (components VI and VII), so the row names VI, the lowest level it carries (D135's rule, as the Abode's III at 25 and 26). The den's 'VII from 100' (m5-plan.md D41; D49: BSD Mage's 30-minute read with the den's kit) is gone: the Holding is the climber's rung. In the level up job's fight the ladder's live cap governs (FightOptions.LiveCap, D129: the highest level at 0.95 on her current, buffed War Magic, which the buff bot's lines lift to about 350, over the 343 VII asks, from 65) and these rows do not lower it; that fight casts VII only once her book holds it (no scrivener sells VII, the loot's: AutopilotScenario.BoltLevel) and her pack pays its formula (components; the Platinum Scarab is a town stock line). Every other fight here keeps these rows as its cap.
sources.components: M6 14 holding safety (the Abode's and the Quarters' general rule, tusker-abode.json sources.components): for each spell level the plan names, the foci formula (GearKit.FociFormulaCounts over the dats' Flame Bolt formulas: the level's scarab, then 4 Prismatic Tapers) and beside it the account formula of 'test' (SpellFormulaRules.CustomizeForAccount, read from the dats; what she casts if she loses her Foci of Strife, HasFoci, Player_Spells.cs 458-488 @95ef426d), pinned by HuntingGroundDatTests.A_climbers_dungeon_carries_the_account_test_formula_beside_the_foci_formula. VI (Flame Bolt VI, spell 85): foci 1 Pyreal Scarab and 4 Prismatic Taper; account Pyreal Scarab, Yellow Taper, Hawthorn, Violet Taper, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Indigo Taper, Birch Talisman (the Abode's and the Quarters' rows). VII (Ilservian's Flame, spell 2128, read from the dats on 2026-11-14; the audit found it recorded nowhere): foci 1 Platinum Scarab and 4 Prismatic Taper; account Platinum Scarab, Pink Taper, Hawthorn, Blue Taper, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Indigo Taper, Birch Talisman. Every taper, herb, powder and talisman is a row of Archmage Cindrue's create list (weenie 2304, destination 4, the pinned world SQL v0.9.296; Value 25 tapers, 10 Hawthorn, 5 the powder, Turpeth and the talisman; 34, 14, 7 pyreals); the Pyreal and Platinum Scarabs are the town stock's (Archmage Sammam al-Ashiz of Uziz). The den's Diamond Scarab 7299 and Lead Scarab 691 lines are gone: no row here burns them.
sources.supplies: M6 14 holding safety (the owner, 2026-11-13: what she carries is computed from burn, not copied from another character's kit; closes m6-holding-supplies): the Abode's general rule (tusker-abode.json sources.supplies), sized from the rung 'holding'. The modelled rate is twice the move-on floor, 172 kills an hour, at the move-on ceiling of 7.3 casts a kill (ladder/war-mage.json) = 1,256 casts an hour, all at the plan's bolt as the worst case, 4 Prismatic Tapers a cast on the foci formula = 5,024 an hour: Prismatic Taper 20631 (Archmage Cindrue, 30) keep 850 = 10 minutes of that burn (837) rounded up to 50, trip_under 300 (a third of the keep rounded up to 50), stop_under 5 (a cast needs 4). The burn is still a profile number, the ladder's model and not her fight's: TODO(m6-derived-supplies): the logistics counters' measured burn an hour (LogisticsCounters, the casts and drinks of her cycles on this ground) times the hours to the next trip (the buff bot's line length) would size every keep here; the study reads about 3.8 Flame Bolt VI a kill at 10 to 11.5 M XP an hour (about 520 casts an hour), under the model. The Silver Scarab 688 keeps 20, trip_under 5, stop_under 2 and the Copper Scarab 686 20, 5, 2 (the Abode's: the level IV item spells of her pass and the four travel spells, GearKit.CastBurns); the Potion of Healing 377 keeps 30, trip_under 6, stop_under 0, listed before the Mana Potion so a short trip budget fills it first, and the Mana Potion 379 100, 10, 0: the Cave's sizing as the Abode's (a drink of 2.5 s is 10 health a second, a way out of 20 to 30 s is 8 to 12 drinks; the Mana Potion the fallback to the Mana Tincture, 2,500 mana), not measured here: TODO(m6-derived-supplies) (the drinks an hour of her fights here). The account formula's lines of levels VI and VII (components) keep 2, trip_under 2, stop_under 2: a backup the focus-holding climber does not burn (the outskirts' rule). No carried line: the den's Gold Scarab 687 line (keep 20, trip_under = stop_under = 2) is gone as m6-goldscarab removed it from the Abode (a carried line under its stop line stops the run by name, LogisticsCounters, and no Holtburg vendor sells it: the ladder's character, never granted anything, would stop at this rung's door); the Gold, Pyreal and Platinum Scarabs are the town stock's, bought at Uziz on the way out; the den's Diamond and Lead Scarab lines are gone with the den's Ring of Fire and level I kit. kit: none, as the Abode's (the den's Faran Robe with Hood, Leather Gauntlets, Wand and two Packs were BSD Mage's; her worn set and caster are the wear and caster scores', GearFloor keeps the floor). burden_trip_percent 150 as the Abode's (the loot section's load line 85 is this ground's trip line, LogisticsCounters). One restock from nothing at these keeps is 65,270 pyreals (850 Prismatic Tapers 25,500; 20 Silver Scarabs 6,760; 20 Copper Scarabs 2,700; 30 Potions of Healing 6,900; 100 Mana Potions 23,000; the nine account lines 410), so the coin is 66,000 (rounded up to 1,000), the Abode's purse; notes of min_note 10,000 and up, the one note the outskirts' placeholder count 1 (TODO(m6-purse-note-count)); the den's 250,000 and 50,000 notes were BSD Mage's.

plates.name: Tusker's Friend
plates.source: M6 14 holding plates (the owner, 2026-11-14: in the Tusker Holding the climber must avoid the Tusker's Friend pressure plates, and where one blocks the way, she can jump; TODO(m6-holding-plates) closed). The points: the pinned world SQL v0.9.296, landblock_instance rows of landblock 0x5B48 with wcid 22719 (18 rows; a read-only SELECT on the world copy, 2026-11-13; HoldingPlatesTests reads the dump): 16 in eight walkable cells of the upper level and two on the lower level's bridge 0x5B4801B0, which no walk reaches (TODO(m6-abode-lower-level)). Weenie 22719 'traptuskerfriendextreme' (PropertyString 1 "Tusker's Friend") is a PressurePlate (WeenieType 24), PhysicsState 0x40C (Ethereal 0x4, ReportCollisions 0x8, Gravity 0x400). Its Setup 0x02000550 (the dats) is one sphere of radius 0.1 m centred (0.0025, -0.1375, 0.073) off its origin, no cylinder and no physics BSP: shape_m 0.24 is that sphere's reach seen from above (0.1375 + 0.1, whatever the plate's heading), and top_m 0.18 the height of her feet over its origin at which her lower sphere (Setup 0x02000001: radius 0.48 at z 0.475) passes over it (0.073 + 0.1 - 0.475 + 0.48 = 0.178). On a level floor her sphere touches it within 0.42 m of its centre; the wall the walks keep is shape_m, her body's 0.48 m and her stop at her live speed (PlateKeepOff). What fires a plate (ACE @95ef426d): PressurePlate.OnCollideObject and OnActivate (PressurePlate.cs:52-94): a player only (63-64), at most once in 2 s (69-73), then its Activation emote unless inside its reset interval (77-92); the collision is the server's sweep of her body (Player.OnCollideObject, Player.cs:368-381; PhysicsObj.FindObjCollisions, PhysicsObj.cs:381-454: an ethereal shape is reported and passed through, except in the step-down) between the positions she reports (Player.UpdatePlayerPosition, Player_Tick.cs:411-479) and along the server's own flight of a jump (Player.HandleActionJump, Player.cs:866-935; UpdateObjectPhysics, Player_Tick.cs:303-313). Nothing in it asks whether she is in the air: a body high enough over the sphere touches nothing. The emote (category 8, emote 27029, actions 19 CastSpellInstant) casts on her Nullify All Magic Other 1878 (the world's spell row: max_Power 285, every school: her own auras of power 250 go, the buff bot's power 300 lines stay) and Tusker's Gift 2166 (the dats: power 325, 240 s, ResistBludgeon x2.85), both Resistable against the plate's ItemSpellcraft 325 (WorldObject_Magic.cs TryResistSpell 119-160). A walk never crosses a plate's wall (the room graph's walls, RoomGraph.PlateList); where the walls close the way she makes a standing long jump over them (PlateJumps), which needs her flight past the walls: her buffed Jump 178 flies 11.54 m with a 2.72 m apex (MovementSystem.GetJumpHeight, 11.6096 0x006B1880), so her feet are over top_m from 0.19 m after the take-off to 0.19 m before the landing.
